metadata.description: Desire Study - held-out validation sets, never used to build a vector
metadata.SexNoDesire: 50 sexual-content-without-desire sentences in five kinds (clinical, professional, informational, logistical, indifferent), new items, not the F controls. Should land near the controls on a real desire vector.
metadata.ImplicitDesire: 50 desire sentences with no explicit vocabulary (anticipation, attraction, closeness, craving, memory). Should land near the desire categories on a real desire vector; if they do not, the vector reads vocabulary.
